Callout.Name: Attempted Break-In
Callout.Advisory: Rear window damaged, offender gone on foot.

Script.Line: I put the light on and he ran.
He had a bar with him. I saw it through the glass.
He went over the back fence and into the alley.

Lines.Approach: They were disturbed and they ran. The window is damaged but nobody is inside.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
